description: Who may open the AI assistant and which features it offers: the bundle gates /ai-agent and the top-bar AI input to the company's system admin, the manual lists features per plan for everyone, and the legacy server picked tools by menu access and plan; the three disagree.

inputSchema.side: bundle (route guard, top bar, menu exclusion) | manual (features per customer kind) | legacy (allowedAssistantTools).
inputSchema.company: {taxPlan: 'taxation'|null, hasPayrollPlan: boolean, hasPartners: boolean, hometaxCertificateLinked: boolean}.

cases.name: bundle: admin who is not the system admin is sent to /dashboard
bundle: general member is sent to /dashboard

manual: tax bookkeeping customer features

legacy: free admin gets knowledge and finance summary only

openQuestions: The bundle limits the assistant to the company's system admin while the manual says it is open to everyone; which reflects the product today is unknown.
The manual lets free customers issue tax invoices through the assistant, but the legacy server offered issue_tax_invoice only to taxation customers.
The manual ties 직원·급여 조회 to tax bookkeeping customers, the legacy server to the payroll plan.
Whether a member's role groups (menu permissions) should narrow the assistant's read tools, as the legacy finance_summary check did, is not stated in the manual.
How write tools (tax invoice issuing, certificate requests) are confirmed and audited is not visible; the API lives in lazy chunks.
Whether conversations are private to the user or shared within the company is unknown.
